name: Nogami Hinoe
source:
She had been training deep in the mountains of Kōya solely to become the best, just like her older brother. There, she ended up learning a martial art called “Divine Fist” from a mysterious figure.
She has a pure heart, but because she’s been living in seclusion in the mountains, she’s a bit out of touch with the outside world.
